reviews.title: Go Cheap but not Spring cheap
reviews.text: This was the first airline ever that accounted our personal neccessities (eg laptop/backpack) with the carry on bag. Both bags together had to be under 7kg. But it wasnt clearly stated plus. You are not able to buy the baggage allowance in advance online as its super unintuitive. The attendants were super rude and had that watchyou gonna do about it attitude. From checkin to boarding. Even when boarding they checked that all of us were carrying at least one bag. As of they were checking for thieves. On the way back we ended missing our flight as they never mentioned a final checkin time we made it about 35 minutes prior to the flight (partially out fault for not adhering to the 2 hour rule) but for this airline there was no mention of a final checkin time for a domestic flight. We missed the window by 5 minutes and just like the staff in tokyo they pretty much said tough dooky. So we took our business to peach instead. Checked bags for those was cheaper too and the service was much more presentable. Maybe in part it was Japanese vs Chinese airline. This is the first time since flying that we missed a flight and it is an expensive lesson learned but i advise everyone if you had the choice between Spring Airlines and any other and had to add a bit more money go for the slightly more expensive airlines. BEWARE OF SPRING!!!! Never again!
reviews.author: LEX

reviews.title: Such a Hand-grabbing money
reviews.text: Its clearly WRITTEN on their own website that maximum baggage is 7kg yet in the check-in counter it’s only allowed below 4kg so they charged me about 3000¥ for the extra weight. AT LEAST WRITE THAT TOO ON YOUR WEBSITE YOU IDIOT. Would never fly again with this airline.
reviews.author: Bunyrabit

reviews.title: Worst experience
reviews.text: I booked the ticket from Hiroshima to Tokyo, they cancel the flight and didn't inform me through mail. I went to the airport to find it out. I called them several times and no kne picked up the phone. I had to return by shinkansen with extra money.
reviews.author: Aheli Roy

reviews.title: Never deal with them
reviews.text: Their morning flights are a swindle scheme. I took the first train in the city possible, yet the online check-in always gave a "your information doesn't match" mistake and when I arrived, the counter was closed 5 minutes earlier than it was supposed to. I wouldn't be surprised if they have some deal with Jetstar for people to buy their emergency tickets because as soon as this circus at Spring Airlines ends, a Jetstar staff goes around to ask if anyone needs tickets to the same destination. Don't even deal with them, ever.
reviews.author: Khitrova Yulia

reviews.title: Don't choose Spring Airlines
reviews.text: My flight has been canceled and it was automatically changed to later flight on the same day without notifying me. And their mail is really misleading as if they're trying trick me into spending more money. Worst experience I've ever had with any airline. I'd never choose nor recommend this airline to anyone ever again. Thank you.
reviews.author: Enguun S

reviews.title: If they cancel, you're screwed
reviews.text: On January 23, 2020,our flight back to Tokyo Narita from Hiroshima at 20h10, we were told that it was cancelled and we have to go online to change the flight and call the service line for help. Nobody from Spring Airlines was there, it was JAL peoples who gave us the info. In your terms and conditions it’s written that you have to take care of your passenger. At least assist them in some way, even so much as a "go this way" would have been something. We had to take a hotel for the night, that was unexpected fees for us. We went online to rebook our flight for the 24th, unable to do it. After a few hours, we were able to start the process, but at the last step we always got an error message saying that because the flight was less than 36 hours ahead we couldn’t have any meal accommodations, from there the whole thing just cancelled itself. No sense in hell whatsoever. We were unable to rebook the flight for the 24th. In the morning of the 24th, we tried again and the only options available was to book for the 25th. We tried to call the service line after 9am, we only got an automated message in Japanese, no message in English. Since it was a day trip for us, we didn’t have any clean clothes. We couldn't pay for another hotel night since we are already paying for a hotel in Tokyo. We had to take the Shinkansen to be able to go back to Tokyo, that was another EXPENSIVE and unexpected fee. Today February 05, 2020, thus far Spring Airlines Japan has done everything to avoid us. Their service line still won't take our call. At Narita airport the Spring front desk person can't help us and just says to keep sending emails to their customer info, to which we've had no replies since January 24, 2020 when we started doing it.
reviews.author: Darryl.B

reviews.title: Horrible Service
reviews.text: We are at the moment traveling from Tokyo to Hokkaido The Ground staff poor in English We send request to book the check in luggages for 15 Kg in advanced via several emails but no response at all, they charge us everything, they weighed our carry on luggage and our purses and there was no way to communicate in a simple way. We asked to book now everything for when we come back in 2 days but nothing is possible, we have to call an “English speaking” call centre 4 hours before departure to try to sort the situation. No way the Supervisor tried to arrange this for us, and when we asked his name he showed us a random card, thinking that we do not understand, it is very disrespectful !! It’s all so complicated and not worth it at all, needs to be avoid !! Avoid
reviews.author: Lin K

reviews.title: Late
reviews.text: I booked through a 3rd party travel agency, Hopper. I had no idea that I selected Spring Airlines, which I never heard of. The price was extremely cheap and now I know why. I can honestly say the staff at the airport was nice but what irritated me was that delayed flight. Our boarding time was 1900 and 22 minutes went by and no once announced the delay. I read the ratings that they’re consistently late and never apologize. I’m truly disappointed that Japan allows this carrier in their airport considering they have a reputation of professionalism. When I use Hopper again, I’ll be sure to pay close attention to the airline carrier. Now I’m going to miss the wedding dinner in Tokyo because of this delay.
reviews.author: Q Knowles

reviews.title: Terrible
reviews.text: Your carry on is limited by 5kg. I have a small backpack with my camera and a few items. They wouldn’t let me carry it on. They nickel and dime you for everything. Like Ryan Air. Terrible service!
reviews.author: 111rand

reviews.title: Great Costpa ! (cost performance in Japanese)
reviews.text: Spring Airlines Japan is based in Narita and 33% is owned by the Chinese low cost carrier - Spring Airlines. Whenever I fly by LLC's my expectations are never high. The main purpose here is the cost factor. If one wants something fancy or over the top in terms of food, service or atmosphere, then fly with the big boys. My trip from Tokyo to Hiroshima was perfect. Right from the check-in process - boarding - inflight - landing - baggage pickup. Everything was smooth & efficient. I paid ¥8K for a one way ticket. FYI the Shinkansen (bullet train) costs ¥19K Just remember, if you are flying with a low cost carrier out of Narita Airport, you gotta keep some time in hand. All flights arrive / depart from Terminal 3. One has to take the shuttle bus from Terminal 2 which takes 5mins or it is a 15min walk. Plus, it is another 10min walk to the gates after checking in. So, once again arrive early or things could get a little tight for you.
reviews.author: Tokyo Local Sites

reviews.title: The worst customer service experience ever
reviews.text: On our way back from Osaka to Tokyo after a wonderful week me and my sisters used the Spring Japan airlines. We had a 4 hours gap between the arrival of the spring flight to Tokyo and the take off of Etihad airline flight. The flight was late way more than promised where they kept saying it will be late for half an hour while it was actually late for over 3 hours. So as expected we miss our flight going to Abu Dhabi and we had to spend another night in Narita airport. When we communicated with the airline they bluntly refused to offer any kind of assistance or arrangements for us to stay using the typhoon an excuse for the delay. The funny things was that the other flights left from and arrived to the airport pretty much as scheduled. I would never recommend this airline to anyone.
reviews.author: Flora_004

reviews.title: Value for Money
reviews.text: took the flight from Hiroshima to Tokyo. it was a good flight and value for money. they are very strict with the luggage size and weight for carry-on so good to know the weight of your carry-on bags/item. the legroom was very narrow though. for someone tall and big, it will not be a comfortable flight. otherwise it was a good flight.
reviews.author: shahrul79

reviews.title: Cheap flight
reviews.text: Cost-performance is great. Specially, if the flight is just of a couple hours. Read the fine print. Some special offers only allows you a single carry-on of 5kg. If you get to the counter with extra bags, even of small size, they will do anything possible to charge you the $50 excess luggage. This is per flight, so can end up spending up to 100$ in a return trip. If you buy in advance, online, it will cost only $20. I think that even paying this extra money is still cheap. For these prices don’t expect on-board entertainment, or a variety of food. This airline is just for going from point A to point B, the cheapest possible. The flight arrived on time, it was clean, and flight attendants were nice and helpful.
reviews.author: Cristian M

reviews.title: Buying checked baggage worth the slight hassle!
reviews.text: Just an update to my earlier post - adding luggage via the Spring Airlines call centre once in Japan worked fine, but the automated recording for credit card payments is in Japanese only. So it helps to have a Japanese speaker with you! It was a little bit of a hassle but I couldn't fault the flight experience from Hiroshima to Narita itself; it was on time, efficient and professional. Spring Airlines does weigh your carry on luggage at check-in though, so ensuring you buy checked baggage if you need it is probably worth the hassle! And the overall price was still significantly cheaper than ANA (also an excellent airline).
reviews.author: Sara D

reviews.title: A good flight for the price
reviews.text: We had to get to Tokyo, Narita, and to buy the ticket from Canada, it was very expensive, but my daughter-in-law booked the flight from Japan and it was very inexpensive. Good flight and comfortable.
reviews.author: 710jeannineb

reviews.title: A low cost company not to be recommended at all
reviews.text: Firstly this company proposes attractive flight pricing but finally they will charge you tremendously in case any of your luggage exceeds 5 Kg weight. Their staff is weighting all your luggage when you are checking in and I was charged 9000 Japanese Yens for carrying a 7 Kg cabin luggage. Of course they do not mention the conditions they apply for extra weight luggage when you purchase the airplane ticket ; I do not know if it is possible to buy extra weight in advance. Of course, you do not expect high quality service and comfort when you are travelling with a low cost company but for me Spring Airlines Japan follows a "small robbers" policy. Their staff is always extremely polite to get your money. Lastly, they are also very flexible in a bad way as boarding time can be terminated before schedule (be careful about their announcements at the airport).
reviews.author: Michael M

reviews.title: Pleasantly Surprised!
reviews.text: From reading reviews about spring airlines, I was expecting some sort of disaster along the line. However, my wife and I found Spring Airlines to be enjoyable, punctual, and with a happy staff. My wife was pregnant at the time, and they made extra sure that she was comfortable.
reviews.author: JT-Alberto

reviews.title: Bad idea, be cautious.
reviews.text: Booked spring airlines through an agent. (Edreams) could not book baggage. Tried so hard to get onto website but could not as only in Japanese. Contacted them through Facebook message and after much back and forth found out cost of baggage but could not book until within Japan. When in Japan went to spring airlines counter at airport as phone call only speaking Japanese. At counter they told me I had to do it online. I explained to them it was not possible and I should be able to pre purchase baggage. Finally after 1 hour of the Japanese lady at the desk talking to spring airlines on phone I was able to purchase the baggage checked for half the price of doing it at check in. It was a mission and stressful. I could not prebook seats either. I was. Travelling with my husband who is 6"1 and they put him in a normal seat with his knees up against the seat in front. The whole 3 rows of bigger leg room - exit rows were left empty! I asked if after takeoff we could move and was told NO. Absolutely the most horrible service ever. Thank heavens it was 80 minutes flight. NEVER AGAIN!!!!
reviews.author: Holly S

reviews.title: Buying check-in luggage allowance on Spring Airlines Japan
reviews.text: My review is premature as I am yet to fly, but I've just received advice from Spring Airlines Japan as to how to pre-purchase check-in luggage allowance. I thought others may find it useful. It is on their website, but only in Japanese. FYI, their online customer service centre responds to emails pretty quickly, and in English. If check-in luggage wasn't part of your ticket, you can only add and pay for it from within Japan, either via their call centre or at check-in. (So don't believe what the Opodo booking engine tells you.) You can do it via the call centre up to 12 hours before your flight. At the airport obviously costs more. So, as they suggest in the attached image, if you are not in the country more than 12 hours pre-flight, you may need to enlist the help of friends or family or some other method within Japan. I have attached the advice and table of costs that they sent me as an image. Good news is, the prices via their call centre aren't too bad. Good luck!
reviews.author: Sara D

reviews.title: No water, Just pay for it.
reviews.text: No serve water, no serve anythings. if you want to eat or drink, just pay for it. the seat was terrible too. Too small. I know this flight is cheap. but really hard work.
reviews.author: HY0801

reviews.title: Pleasant flight, no English reservations for certain destinations
reviews.text: A few days ago a friend and I traveled from Hiroshima to Narita. Everything went well except some noisy passengers (which is not the airline's fault). The check-in went smooth, the flight was on time, the cabin crew was helpful, kind and English-speaking, the seats were quite comfortable, the prices were quite okay (and we booked 2-3 weeks before the departure). The only problem is that the online reservations for this destination Hiroshima-Narita or vice versa can be done only in Japanese - so either you ask somebody to help you or use a tool like Google Translate.
reviews.author: iris_marron

reviews.title: Beware! Never use this airline!
reviews.text: 1. There is no english speaking attendants 2. The contact numbers they mention online are all dead, making it impossible to contact them. 3. They cancel frequently flights without taking any responsibility (I just lost three connecting flights because of them) 4. The staff is not prepared properly and will offer no help if something goes wrong (they not even could lend me their phone to call the airline and try to rearrange my next flights). 5. The staff openly says that because it is a cheap flight, it means that you must put yourself in risk (ok. I know it is cheap but this is completely unprofessional!!!) In conclusion. Unless you are ready to loose a lot of money and willing to put yourself and your belongings in risk, never use them. (I lost around a thousand euros and two days because of the mess they created).
reviews.author: hayaoyamaneko

reviews.title: Narita to Hiroshima IJ621
reviews.text: Had a very enjoyable 1hr 20m flight to Hiroshima with Spring Airlines. As they do not have a English website I had to use a page translator to make my booking online. It took a few hours to get it right but no problems from there on. Check in at the airport was smooth and hassle free. The best part of the trip was boarding our aircraft, it appeared to be a brand new B737-800. Smelled like a new car inside, super clean and bright interior with leather upholstered seats. Cabin crew were helpful and happy. 10 out of 10 to Spring Air.
reviews.author: TroyWe

reviews.title: Not good for rainy or bad weather day
reviews.text: I have travelled through this flight to Hiroshima, but due to bad weather flight was not able for lending due to inappropriate mechanism of the flights. Because at the same weather condition all flights landed successfully without delay but our flights got delayed by 5 hours. So first experience was not good. But inside flights leg space and other things are upto the mark. It is the cheapest flight to hirsohima.
reviews.author: Virendra-Yadav_2014
